description_en: Submit a job to generate a 2D digital human video offline based on a piece of text. This API immediately returns a TaskUuid as the unique ID for the submitted job. You can later use this TaskUuid to invoke the query and cancel job APIs
description_zh: 提交根据一段文本离线生成2D数字人视频任务，该接口会立即返回一个TaskUuid作为本次提交任务的唯一id，后续可以根据TaskUuid调用查询和取消任务接口
kebab_example: aliyun avatar submit-text-to-2d-avatar-video-task --tenant-id 1 --app AppId=3d95xx946a --title '这是一个示例标题' --text '这是一个示例文本' --region cn-hangzhou
name: SubmitTextTo2DAvatarVideoTask

fields.help_en:
Alpha channel format. Default value: 1.  
1: webm  
2: mov  
3: mp4  

<notice>When isAlpha is false, this field is ignored. Transparent videos in mov format result in very large file sizes and are not recommended. Use webm or mp4 instead.</notice>  
<notice>Some 2D photorealistic digital humans do not support transparent video formats. Currently, official platform digital humans support transparent output. For custom avatars, transparency depends on the selection made during customization.</notice>
fields.help_zh:
透明通道格式 ，默认值1
1：webm
2：mov
3：mp4


<notice>当isAlpha为false时，该字段忽略。mov格式的透明视频文件大小会非常大，不推荐使用，建议使用webm或者mp4。></notice>
<notice>2D真人数字人部分人物不支持透明格式视频，目前平台官方数字人支持输出透明格式，定制形象需以定制时选择是否透明为准。></notice>

fields.help_en:

The resolution of the background image must match the resolution of the generated video.

Supported image formats include JPG, JPEG, and PNG

有效可访问的url背景图片地址；

fields.help_en:
Whether to enable the alpha channel. Default value: false.  
true: Enables the alpha channel. The video format can be specified via AlphaFormat and supports webm, mov, or mp4.  
false: Disables the alpha channel. The video format is mp4

是否需要透明通道， 默认false
true： 开启透明通道，视频格式可通过AlphaFormat指定，支持webm、mov、mp4
false：不开启透明通道，视频格式为mp4

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to generate captions. Default value: true.

true: Captions are generated in the ASS file format and provided as a separate subtitle file with a download link.
false: Captions are not generated.

<warning>This field is deprecated. Regardless of whether you set this field to true or false, a separate subtitle file is always generated. Use the SubtitleEmbedded field to control whether captions are merged into the video.</warning>
fields.help_zh:
是否需要字幕，默认值：true

true： 生成字幕，字幕文件格式为ass文件，会作为独立文件提供下载链接进行下载
false：不生成字幕

<warning>该字段已废弃，传入true和false都会生成单独字幕文件，新增SubtitleEmbedded字段可控制是否将字幕合并到视频中。></warning>

fields.help_en:
The speech rate of the TTS voice. Value range: -500 to 500. If not specified, the default value configured in the asset is used.

The values [-500, 0, 500] correspond to speech rate multipliers in the range [0.5, 1.0, 2.0]:

-500 represents 0.5× the base speech rate;  
0 represents 1.0× the base speech rate. The base rate refers to the model's default synthesized speech speed, which varies slightly by speaker and is approximately four Chinese characters per second;  
500 represents 2.0× the base speech rate.

The calculation method is as follows:

For 0.8× speed: (1 - 1/0.8) / 0.002 = -125  
For 1.2× speed: (1 - 1/1.2) / 0.001 = 166
fields.help_zh:
TTS播报声音语速，取值范围：-500～500，不传则使用资产中配置的默认值。

[-500, 0, 500] 对应的语速倍速区间为 [0.5, 1.0, 2.0]。

-500表示基准语速的0.5倍速；
0表示基准语速的1倍速。1倍速是指模型默认输出的合成语速，语速会依据每一个发音人略有不同，大概每秒钟4个字左右；
500表示基准语速的2倍速；

计算方法如下：

0.8倍速（1-1/0.8)/0.002 = -125

1.2倍速（1-1/1.2)/0.001 = 166

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable management event callbacks for this video synthesis job. The default value is false, which means no callback. The platform supports callbacks at the start and end of a job. For more information, see the document: Digital Human Callback Event Notifications (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2261152.html?spm=a2c4g.447644.0.0.406f5876hRJTVU)
